## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit (`feat(engine): …`, `fix(web): …`)
- [ ] No club maps, map geometry or coordinates are committed or sent to the AI assistant or any server
- [ ] Rule values cite their IOF or SSL source
- [ ] User-facing text is in the message catalogues (`apps/web/src/i18n/`)
